category_title: Struggling students using infinite practice for mastery
scenario_title: Repeated errors during self-paced computer lab practice
minimal_context: The student is working on self-paced math exercises in a computer lab to master a procedure.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Please continue working on your math exercises on the computer. Remember, you need to get five in a row correct.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I just got that one wrong. I'm going to try the exact same strategy on this next problem and see if it works this time.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Okay, go ahead and try the next one.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: It marked it wrong again. I tried asking my partner for help, but we have unique problems on our screens so we have to work through the procedure together instead of just sharing the solution.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Why don't you try watching the video lesson on the screen?

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: The teacher can teach me more than the video. I've just been repeating the same strategy for the last few problems and getting them all wrong, so I need you to come over here and help me.
